title: RPM Jade Elongated 14mm & 16mm Pickleball Paddle
html:
Meet the RPM Jade Elongated, RPM's full-foam paddle built for players who want heavy spin and lively power without giving up feel. The elongated shape (16.5in x 7.5in) adds reach and leverage for attacking play.

Its silicon carbide hitting surface is made to grip the ball for topspin drives, rolls and sharp angles, and to keep that grit for longer. Underneath, a floating foam core and carbon layup give a responsive, stable hit across the face.

14mm is the firmer, faster option, with a crisper pop for quick hands and counters.
16mm holds the ball a little longer, for a softer, steadier feel on blocks, resets and dinks.

✅ Silicon carbide surface for long-lasting spin
✅ Full-foam core construction
✅ Elongated shape for extra reach
✅ Available in 14mm and 16mm
✅ USA Pickleball approved
